summary: [standards] RETRIEVE_INVALID is the only one of the 50 renamed codes with no test that makes a real call raise it: exit_registry.rs only reads its registry row, which the brief says is no proof (F1 acceptance). The call does raise it (canon retrieve --for-role implementer --domain '' exits 2 RETRIEVE_INVALID, retryable false; one site, run/top.rs:224) and RETRIEVE_FAILED had no real-call test before either. Blast radius: a call site that stopped raising it would pass the registry tests.
